newsitem.headline: TABLE - Griffin Land Q2 net increases.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Net income for the second quarter of 1996 included the $272,000, or 0.06 per share, for the discontinued operations of CMS Gilbreth Packaging Systems Inc which was sold in November 1996.
The company said it reported proforma average shares outstanding and since Griffin was spun off to Culbro Corp shareholders on July 3.
The second quarter and first six months of 1997 include the income from Griffin's 25 percent equity investment in Centaur Communications.

The company said all results reflect interest expense on the company's general corporate debt that was assumed, as of February 27, by Griffin's former affiliate General Cigar Holdings Inc as part of the distribution agreement relating to the spinoff of Griffin.
